newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Orchard Parade performance to improve.
newsitem.headline: Orchard Parade performance to improve.

text.p: Hotel and property group Orchard Parade Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it expected overall performance of the group to continue to improve.
It said in announcing its 1996 results that: "the directors expect the overall performance of the group in 1997 to continue to improve."

The property development division would continue to generate a steady stream of profits, and there should be a positive contribution from sale of units in some residential development projects, Orchard Parade said in a statement. But it said the results of the hotel division were expected to be lower.
Orchard Parade reported a 109.7 percent increase in net profit to Singapore $24.82 million for 1996.
